intent: tpunit fixture exercising the Jobs plugin's bulk GetJobs command: fetching multiple jobs moves them to RUNQUEUED with a retryAfter-based nextRun, and after FinishJob each repeat modifier reschedules nextRun from the correct reference timestamp.

objects.name: absoluteDiff
objects.role: unsigned seconds between two time_t values regardless of order

objects.name: getAllJobData
objects.role: runs a raw Query command with -json ReadDBFlags to pull jobID/state/lastRun/nextRun for every jobs row

objects.name: GetJobsTest
objects.role: single test creating three jobs with different repeat modifiers, fetching via GetJobs, then finishing and checking reschedule

misfits.why: declared as plain file-scope free functions rather than static or in an anonymous namespace, unlike sibling test files which keep all helper logic inside the fixture struct; leaks symbol names into the test binary's global namespace

name_fit.note: Matches the GetJobs (plural/bulk) command it tests.

location_fit.note: Grouped with other per-command Jobs plugin tests.

naming_quality.note: Names are clear; docked only for the file-scope-vs-anonymous-namespace helper placement noted above.
